---
title: "Activos"
---

```{=html}
<div class="tf-page-header"><div><h1>Activos productivos</h1><div class="tf-muted">Patrimonio productivo, depreciación, costos y recuperación económica.</div></div><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" data-logout>Cerrar sesión</button></div>
<div class="tf-actions" style="margin-bottom:1rem"><button id="asset-new" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary" type="button">Nuevo activo</button><button id="asset-archived-toggle" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button" hidden>Archivados</button></div>

<section class="tf-card"><div class="tf-table-wrap"><table class="tf-table"><thead><tr><th>Activo</th><th>Tipo</th><th class="tf-num">Costo capitalizado</th><th class="tf-num">Valor actual</th><th>Contratos</th><th>Estado</th><th>Información</th></tr></thead><tbody id="asset-list"></tbody></table></div></section>

<dialog id="asset-editor" class="tf-modal-dialog"><div class="tf-modal-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Activo</div><h2 id="asset-editor-title">Nuevo activo</h2></div><button id="asset-editor-close" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cerrar</button></div><form id="asset-form" class="tf-form-grid"><input id="asset-id" type="hidden">
<div class="tf-field"><label>Nombre</label><input id="asset-name" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Tipo</label><select id="asset-type"><option value="computer">Computadora / estación de trabajo</option><option value="survey">Equipo topográfico</option><option value="equipment">Otro equipo</option><option value="vehicle">Vehículo</option><option value="other">Otro</option></select></div>
<div class="tf-field"><label>Precio de compra ($)</label><input id="asset-purchase" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Impuestos no recuperables ($)</label><input id="asset-taxes" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Envío / transporte inicial ($)</label><input id="asset-purchase-transport" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Seguro de transporte ($)</label><input id="asset-purchase-insurance" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Accesorios indispensables ($)</label><input id="asset-accessories" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Certificación / calibración inicial ($)</label><input id="asset-certification" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Ensamblaje / configuración inicial ($)</label><input id="asset-setup" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Otros costos iniciales ($)</label><input id="asset-other-initial" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div>
<div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha compra</label><input id="asset-date" type="date" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Puesta en servicio</label><input id="asset-commissioning" type="date"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Valor residual ($)</label><input id="asset-residual" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Vida útil (años)</label><input id="asset-life" type="number" min="0.1" step="0.1" value="5"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Costo financiero total esperado ($)</label><input id="asset-financing" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Valor de mercado actual ($, opcional)</label><input id="asset-market" type="number" min="0" step="0.01"></div>
<div id="asset-purchase-flow" class="tf-span-2 tf-card" style="padding:.8rem"><label style="display:flex;gap:.55rem;align-items:center"><input id="asset-historical" type="checkbox"> Activo histórico / compra anterior al tracker (no crear movimiento)</label><div class="tf-field" style="margin-top:.7rem"><label>Cuenta desde la que se pagó la compra</label><select id="asset-account"></select></div><div class="tf-muted" style="margin-top:.35rem">Si no es histórico, el costo inicial completo se registra una sola vez como egreso y queda vinculado al activo.</div></div>
<div class="tf-span-2 tf-actions"><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Guardar activo</button><button id="asset-cancel" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Cancelar</button></div></form></dialog>

<dialog id="asset-event-editor" class="tf-modal-dialog"><div class="tf-modal-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Activo</div><h2>Registrar evento</h2></div><button id="asset-event-close" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cerrar</button></div><form id="asset-event-form" class="tf-form-grid"><input id="event-asset" type="hidden"><div class="tf-field"><label>Tratamiento</label><select id="event-kind"><option value="operating_cost">Costo operativo</option><option value="capital_improvement">Mejora capitalizable</option><option value="revenue">Ingreso directo del activo</option></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Concepto</label><select id="event-concept"><option value="maintenance">Mantenimiento</option><option value="calibration">Calibración / certificación</option><option value="repair">Reparación</option><option value="insurance">Seguro</option><option value="improvement">Mejora / ampliación</option><option value="rental">Arriendo / uso productivo</option><option value="other">Otro</option></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha</label><input id="event-date" type="date" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Monto total ($)</label><input id="event-amount" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Cuenta</label><select id="event-account" required></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label style="display:flex;gap:.5rem;align-items:center"><input id="event-has-invoice" type="checkbox"> Tiene factura / IVA</label></div><div id="event-invoice-fields" class="tf-span-2 tf-form-grid" hidden><div class="tf-field"><label>Número de factura</label><input id="event-invoice-number"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>IVA incluido ($)</label><input id="event-vat" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div></div><div class="tf-field tf-span-2"><label>Detalle</label><input id="event-note"></div><div class="tf-span-2 tf-actions"><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Registrar</button><button id="asset-event-cancel" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Cancelar</button></div></form></dialog>

<dialog id="asset-detail-dialog" class="tf-modal-dialog"><div class="tf-modal-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Activo</div><h2 id="asset-detail-title">Información</h2></div><button id="asset-detail-close" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cerrar</button></div><div id="asset-detail-body"></div></dialog>
<script type="module" src="js/assets.js?v=1.0.89"></script>
```
